purpose: Lift Wind's largest missing block: strong-wind nights are not forecast (deterministic NBM v5.0 POD 0 at every lead on 49 observed night >= 15 mph events, CAL+H1). Pre-register two candidate detection methods, an independent past-window test on data the project has not read, and the one-shot confirmatory test on H2 at unseal.

versionTransferCaveat.statement: The past window is NBM pre-v4.3 (v4.2) in winter and spring; CAL+H1 and H2 are NBM v5.0. Two generations separate them: v4.3 (2025-05-27) and v5.0 (2026-05-05, which re-calibrated wind speed and gust, SCN 26-24). A past-window result measures the methods on an older model and is NOT a measurement of today's forecast.
consequences: M-B is fitted on v5.0 (CAL+H1, May-October) and applied to v4.2 (PW, January-May). Any v4.2/v5.0 difference in the upper tail of 10 m speed shifts its map: a PW failure of M-B can be a version artifact, and a PW pass does not prove v5.0 skill.
M-A has no fitted parameter; it transfers only through the definition and calibration of the qmd 90% level, which may differ between v4.2 and v5.0.
B0 on PW is a v4.2 measurement. It never replaces the v5.0 CAL+H1 WI4 fact.
Season differs too (CAL+H1 warm season, PW winter-spring, H2 autumn-early winter); the season effect cannot be separated from the version effect on PW.
If the bucket has no qmd 90% level for PW, M-A is NOT_EVALUABLE there; B0 and M-B are still scored, but the past window then tests only M-B.
versionTransferCaveat.howTheResultIsUsed: PW evidence can reach INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED only for the NBM v4.2 winter-spring regime, and is labelled so. Only the H2 confirmatory score (same generation, v5.0) can close WIND-CNF-001 under its stop condition.

stations.set: 8A1, 4A6 Guntersville; DCU, HSV, 9A4 Wheeler; MSL Wilson; SNH, 15M Pickwick (brains/wind/runtime/lakes.json)
stations.rule: The runner refuses to run if lakes.json differs from this sha256 or its station set differs from these 8 ids.
stations.note: Four are AWOS, four ASOS; the IEM archive serves both. Same stations as the WI4 fact.

truth.source: Iowa Environmental Mesonet ASOS/AWOS archive (https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/request/asos.py), report types 3 and 4, fields sknt, drct, gust. Registered research source iem-asos. Independent of every forecast.
truth.pairing: For each station and valid hour, the report within 10 minutes of the top of the hour, nearest wins (sector_wind.validate.load_obs). Missing sknt = no observation (row dropped).

forecastRows.inits: synoptic cycles only (00, 06, 12, 18Z), in every window including the CAL_H1 fit, because the qmd percentiles that M-A needs exist only for those cycles.
forecastRows.night: valid hour (UTC) in 01..08 inclusive (sector_wind.validate._night), as the WI4 fact. In local time this is 19:00-02:59 CST or 20:00-03:59 CDT: the local window shifts by one hour at the daylight-saving change (2025-03-09 is inside PW). It is not the pW15 shadow's local-standard night (pw15.local_night).
forecastRows.pairs: 00Z leads 1/3/6, 06Z lead 1, 12Z lead 18, 18Z lead 12 (the synoptic (init, lead) pairs whose valid hour is night).
forecastRows.fetch: sector_wind.ingest.ingest_nbm_cycle (same decoder, row-scan fix and self-check as the corpus) into a local store; NBM core WIND/WDIR/GUST and qmd WIND 10/50/90% and GUST 90% levels at 10 m. Only lake cut-outs are written to disk.
forecastRows.stationValue: bilinear blend of the lake cut-out at the station (sector_wind.interp.CutoutIndex.weights). Deterministic speed: blend_wind (as validate.collect). P90 speed: blend of speedP90.
forecastRows.missing: See accounting: nothing is dropped silently.

event.definition: observed sustained 10 m speed >= 15 mph (6.7056 m/s) at a night valid hour (scoreboard dimension 1 / WI4 event).

B0.name: deterministic NBM (reference)
B0.rule: forecast event iff blended deterministic speed >= 6.7056 m/s

M-A.name: NBM P90 exceedance
M-A.rule: forecast event iff blended qmd WIND 90% level >= 6.7056 m/s
M-A.relationToPw15: M-A is close to the frozen pW15 rule: 'P90 >= 15 mph' is roughly 'pW15 >= 0.10', where the pW15 shadow flag uses pW15 >= 0.15 and only when deterministic NBM is under 15 mph. They are different thresholds on the same qmd tail, not independent evidence.

M-B.name: night upper-tail quantile mapping
M-B.rule: forecast event iff QM(blended deterministic speed) >= 6.7056 m/s

fit.data: CAL_H1 only: every scored row (forecastRows, accounting) of the CAL_H1 synoptic night pairs, pairs (deterministic speed, observed speed) where both exist, pooled over stations and leads. The runner refuses a fit row whose init is outside 2026-05-06T00Z..2026-10-06T23Z or whose valid time is on or after 2026-10-07T00Z, and refuses to fit if any planned CAL_H1 cycle is missing or incomplete. The fit refuses if any planned CAL_H1 observation day file is missing, or if more than 5% of planned rows (15% at any station) have no observation; rows without an observation are excluded from the fit pairs and counted in the fit's accounting. With --corpus-store, the corpus path and the tree hash of its nbm/ and metar/ objects are bound as the fit's inputs in the run ledger, and the path is recorded in the fit's args.
fit.map: F_k = forecast quantile at level k, O_k = observed quantile at level k, D_k = O_k - F_k. QM(f) = f + D(f) with D linear in f between consecutive (F_k, D_k); D = D at the lowest knot below it and D = D at the highest knot above it. Ties in F_k are merged into one knot whose D is the mean of the tied D_k.
fit.output: wsw-mb-fit.json, written once; its sha256 is the 'fit' output of the counted fit:cal_h1 ledger entry. Every later past-window or H2 step must be given --fit-sha equal to it.

scoring.rowSet: scored rows: every built row that has an observation. All methods are scored on the same rows; a missing method value is 'no event forecast' (accounting.forecastSideValueGaps).
scoring.perLead: hits, misses, false alarms, POD, FAR, CSI, observed and forecast events
scoring.wi4Credit: as the production scorer (sector_brain_platform.wind_measurements WI4 with measurement_evidence): over the leads that have rows, min POD credit (linear 0 -> 0, 0.5 -> 1; no observed events at a lead -> 0) x min FAR credit (linear 0.8 -> 0, 0.5 -> 1; no forecast events -> 1); no observed events at all -> 0. A lead with no rows is left out, as production does.
scoring.scoreboardGate: scoreboard.py dimension 1: over the leads that have rows, POD >= 0.5 and (FAR <= 0.5 or no forecast events) at every lead.
scoring.uncertainty: block bootstrap over UTC valid dates, exactly 2000 resamples, seed 20261123, for pooled POD, FAR, CSI and the paired difference CSI(method) - CSI(B0). The resample count is fixed in code.

multipleComparisons.PW: two candidates (M-A, M-B): Bonferroni; lower bound = 1.25th percentile of the paired CSI difference.
multipleComparisons.H2: the H2 candidate family across protocols is four rules: the frozen pW15 rule (p* = 0.15, W-NOW-2/3; it only lowers confidence), the CAL-only probability recalibration (prob_recal.py, E15), M-A and M-B. Bonferroni over four: the H2 lower bound for M-A and M-B is the 0.625th percentile. The other two are scored under their own pre-registrations; this protocol does not score them.

decision.minimumEvidence: at least 25 observed events in the scored rows; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS. INCOMPLETE and NOT_EVALUABLE as in accounting. None of these is ever a pass.
decision.supported: per method: the lower bound of CSI(method) - CSI(B0) > 0, pooled POD >= 0.25 and pooled FAR <= 0.80.
decision.reporting: every outcome is reported together with the method's WI4 credit and scoreboard gate, so SUPPORTED is never shown alone.
decision.pastWindowOutcome: SUPPORTED | NOT_SUPPORTED | INSUFFICIENT_EVENTS | NOT_EVALUABLE | INCOMPLETE per method, labelled 'NBM v4.2 winter-spring (version-transfer caveat)'.
decision.h2Outcome: the same rule on H2, once, with the four-rule correction. SUPPORTED on H2 -> recommendation ACCEPT for a versioned strong-wind signal that may only LOWER the exposure assessment's confidence (WIND-CNF-001 expectedOutput); otherwise REJECT. Both methods are scored on H2 whatever the PW result.
decision.noChangesAfterResults: No method is chosen, re-fitted or re-thresholded after a PW or H2 result. A changed method needs a new protocol id and data not used to choose it (RS-18, RS-30).

outputsAndAdmission.writes: local files under the Wind research folder that Cortex research-path returns, on the Mac mini's research SSD. Never the boot disk and never Michael's MacBook Pro. No Firebase, no bucket, no score file, no evidence file in the repository, no schedule, no cloud job. A recorded result is never overwritten, and the shared run ledger (runBinding) makes every step's first counted run the only one that counts.
outputsAndAdmission.admission: Nothing here changes WI4, the wind-measurements-evidence file, frozen-scores.json or any published score. A future evidence change is proposed as a candidate block through jobs/brain-scores/refresh_wind_score.py (anything other than live reliability is HELD) and Michael's decision. Whether a post-processed signal may earn WI4 credit ('deterministic' in the item) is a rubric-governance question for Michael.

budget.enforcedInCode: per window, a cumulative byte counter and wall clock across runs (runBinding.budget). Every attempt is counted, retries and partial reads included; redirects are refused; free space is checked before each cycle and each observation day; the budget is saved after each cycle and day and on SIGTERM/SIGINT. Limit: a SIGKILL or power loss loses at most the accounting of the cycle in progress.
hosts: noaa-nbm-grib2-pds.s3.amazonaws.com (NOAA Open Data Dissemination, public, no credentials)
budget.hostCheck: every request's host is checked against this list before it is sent, and redirects are refused, so a request never leaves the list

accounting.principle: Unknowns count against a method (Michael's rule). Every planned station-row is accounted for, and every result carries the counts below.
counts: plannedPairs and plannedRows (= planned pairs x 8 stations)
missingCycles (a planned lake cycle with no stored object)
incompleteCycles (stored with status other than 'complete', or without the planned lead)
accounting.forecastSideCycleGaps: If any planned lake cycle is missing or incomplete, the window result is INCOMPLETE for every method and earns nothing. The rows file is still written (with the counts) so the gap is visible.
accounting.forecastSideValueGaps: A row with an observation whose method value is missing (B0/M-B: no deterministic speed at the station; M-A: no 90% level) is scored as 'no event forecast' for that method: a miss when the event happened. It is counted (b0Missing, p90Missing), never dropped.
accounting.truthSideGaps: A planned observation day with no stored METAR file makes fit and rows refuse (it is a truth-side cycle gap). A row with no observation (no report within 10 minutes of the hour) has no truth, so it cannot be scored; it is counted (obsMissing, per station) and charged against every method through the window: if more than 5% of planned rows overall, or more than 15% of planned rows at any one station, have no observation, the window result is INCOMPLETE for every method and earns nothing. Rows are never deleted between fetch and rows without detection: the input manifest (runBinding) fixes the stores before rows are built.
accounting.qmdAbsent: If fewer than 80% of the scored rows have a 90% level, M-A is NOT_EVALUABLE (the bucket likely serves no qmd percentiles for that generation); B0 and M-B are still scored.

runBinding.principle: One run ledger per protocol id, kept by the shared module tools/research/protocol_run_ledger.py (Engine PR #251) and tracked by public comments on Sector_Ops #51 that a local copy cannot take back. Only the first counted run of a step counts.
runBinding.module: protocol_run_ledger.Ledger.for_brain('wind', 'WSW-2026-11-23-R5', <this sha256>, result_steps=RESULT_STEPS), with --out folders passed as forbid_under. The research root is the folder Cortex research-path returns for wind (CORTEX_HOME must be set; SECTOR_RESEARCH_ROOT, if set, must equal it). The ledger is <root>/_ledgers/WSW-2026-11-23-R5.jsonl with its head file. SECTOR_RESEARCH_HOME is not used.
runBinding.keyRule: Keys are '<step>:<window>' (fetch adds ':<YYYY-MM>' or ':smoke'), exactly the list above. fetch:pw:smoke fetches the first 6 night pairs of 2025-01. No key is derived from the time, the folder, the host or the run.
runBinding.anchor: Before ANY step (fetch included), the anchor comment from post_anchor_text() is posted on #51 ('Run anchor: WSW-2026-11-23-R5 <anchor> fit,rows,score <this sha256>'). Every begin() refuses unless it is the protocol's earliest anchor and predates the ledger's first start.
runBinding.resultStepSequence: For fit, rows and score, in one process: begin -> the runner writes start_text() to a pending file and the Mac mini session posts it on #51 exactly once -> confirm_started() (if not listed yet: wait and retry; never repost) -> compute -> record_outputs/complete -> the runner writes result_text() to a pending file and the session posts it once -> confirm_result() (wait and retry; never repost; the confirm-result command retries later if the process ended). The anchor, start and result comments are research records (standing approval item 7), never 'Owner approval' comments, and nobody edits or deletes them.
runBinding.oneShot: Every (step, key) runs once: begin() refuses a key with a COMPLETED run. An error before any output is closed with abort_before_result() and may be retried; a STARTED attempt with no end (for example after a SIGKILL or a power loss) is terminal for that key. Recovery is a new protocol id plus a revised protocol document recorded in a #51 human review.
runBinding.fitSha: The fit's sha256 is the 'fit' output of the counted fit:cal_h1 entry (require('fit', 'fit:cal_h1')). Every past-window and H2 fetch, rows and score needs --fit-sha equal to it, and the fit file in --out must match it.
runBinding.inputs: rows binds its inputs with bind_inputs before begin: tree hashes of the window store's nbm/, metar/ and grids/, lakes.json, the runner, the ledger module and the Wind runtime (sector_wind/). score re-checks them with check_inputs and refuses on any difference. No fetch is allowed for a window once rows has begun. fit binds the CAL+H1 store's nbm/ and metar/ tree hashes (the --corpus-store may lie outside the research root; its path is recorded in the fit's args).
runBinding.clock: The runner refuses any step when the system clock is earlier than the newest ledger entry, and refuses H2 when the ledger has any H2 entry dated before 2027-01-01. Reliance on the system clock is disclosed; the #51 timestamps are the public check.
runBinding.budget: budget-<window>.json files live next to the ledger (<root>/_ledgers/WSW-2026-11-23-R5.budget-<window>.json), written atomically.
runBinding.results: Every result records its run number, counted flag, the ledger anchor, the code identity (runner and module sha256, Wind runtime tree hash, git commit and dirty flag) and the input hashes. Runners print audit() into their reports.
runBinding.limits: As stated in the module's threat model: it stops careless and non-disclosing re-runs, not a deliberate actor holding the same credentials; the public #51 trail plus human review is the assurance. Refused calls write nothing to the ledger.
